limitations: This independently verifies retained execution evidence; no native binaries were rerun during review.
Both native parent tests intentionally fail. Their successful regression verdict means the exact old numeric defect was observed, not that the parent is correct.
Native binaries, object files and full tool/library bytes are not archived; their recorded before/after identities cannot be freshly rehashed from this archive.
The RTL test instantiates VX_dcr_data plus VX_csr_mpm, not the complete AFU or architectural CSR datapath. Linked SimX uses the actual model route with stable seeded counters and no simulation ticks.
TCU and other extension-enabled paths, wider topology, live counter concurrency, atomic snapshots and an absolute no-wrap bound remain unqualified.
The strict execution record retains formal_qualification_eligible=true with qualified=false; this review does not replace a future versioned warm qualification binding.
No phase acceptance, historical warm qualification, performance speedup, physical hardware result or circuit-gate pass is asserted.
Resource enforcement uses sampled process budgets; recorded RSS may miss between-poll peaks and excludes page cache.
